evidence_scope: Effects use one common terminal cohort across all six methods, paired within lifecycle then averaged equally across lifecycles. Selecting four steps demonstrates candidate differentiation, not improved return. Cutoffs retain costs but are not terminal failures. V83 acquisition and V84 anchor fitting are reused and reported once from final checkpoints; new work consists of residual fitting and evaluation. Shared method construction attributions and concurrent lifecycle seconds must not be summed as actual wall time.
